Marta (Marketing): Quick check-in on landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private — aim to lock a variant for staging today.

Sam (Growth): Need: crystal CTAs for self-serve vs sales. My proposal: "Start Hosted free" (self-serve) and "Schedule Dedicated/Private demo" (sales). Keep hero subhead <= 12 words.

Anya (UX): Two compact hero options: 
- "Production LLM inference, one API."
- "Ship reliable LLM features with predictable cost."
Microcopy for CTAs: "Start free" / "Book demo".

Leo (Product): Short benchmark blurbs for hero area: "Production-profiled: up to 1.2M tokens/sec; ~30% lower per-token cost vs baseline." Link to full benchmark below. For Dedicated page: "Reserved GPU pools • Configurable autoscale • SLA-backed latency targets." For Private page: "VPC & on-prem options • KMS/HSM support • Audit logs."

Marta (Marketing): Webinar CTA (small): "Live launch demo & Q&A". Longer promo: "45-min walkthrough showing Hosted, Dedicated, Private in real workloads." Keep hero CTA short.

Priya (Growth Ops): Routing rules draft: 
- Form field "Deployment interest": hosted,dedicated,private.
- If deployment != hosted OR company_size > 250 => route to #leads-enterprise and create SF lead Tier=Enterprise.
- Else => #leads-self-serve and tag utm_campaign=hosted-try.
- Webinar registrants: tag webinar:launch-2; if company_size>100 => assign AE follow-up.
- Required fields: name,email,company,company_size,use_case,consent.
- Slack webhook payload example (stringified in code): {"channel":"#leads-enterprise","priority":"high","email":"..."}.

Sam (Growth): Add safety gate: if email domain matches major cloud vendor or competitor => route to #growth-review for manual triage.

Anya (UX): A/B plan: Variant A shows stat block under hero (trust); Variant B emphasizes developer value first. Keep CTA identical to measure conversion.

Marta (Marketing): Action list: Anya — finalize A/B hero copy by EOD. Leo — confirm benchmark sentence and page bullets. Priya — ship webhook spec and create SF queues. Sam — draft webinar email series and quick A/B test plan.

deploy-bot: "Reminder: merge marketing-site branch by EOD Thu to hit launch timeline. CI: 2 failing tests." :warning:
